name: Objectways
short: Egocentric, depth and teleoperation data for embodied AI, on demand.

tasks: egocentric first-person video of household tasks (kitchen, bedroom, living room, bathroom)
on-demand custom collection and access to pre-collected datasets

pricing.notes: No price is published; datasets and collection are requested through the contact form.

latency.notes: No turnaround is stated on the embodied-AI, egocentric or home pages.

freshness.notes: The page offers both 'On-demand data collection' and 'Access to pre-collected datasets'; the latter is archive, not a commission.

coverage.notes: The pages list offices in Phoenix, Mesa and Scottsdale, Arizona, and Karur, Coimbatore and Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Where data is collected is not stated.

licensing.summary: Nothing is stated about ownership, licence, AI training or resale of delivered datasets. The Terms of Use cover the website and its 'Submissions' ('Objectways does not claim ownership of the materials you provide'), and a section on a recording app says app data is 'used solely for egocentric activity research and dataset collection purposes'. Neither addresses client deliverables.

human.unknown: No identity check of collectors is documented.

application.unknown: No capture-app or device attestation is documented.

camera.unknown: Capture devices are not stated on the egocentric page; no C2PA or signed capture, and Objectways is not on the C2PA conforming products list.

time.unknown: No signed or independently time-stamped capture times are documented.

content.method: Datasets list container, codec, resolution and frame rate (MP4/H.264, 1920x1080, 29.97 fps); site claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 (organisation-level).
content.unknown: Capture QC and acceptance criteria are not published; certifications cover the organisation, not the data.

corroboration.unknown: No independent check of collected data is documented.

auth.how_to_get: Order form or sales@objectways.com via objectways.com/contact-us/.

mcp.notes: No server found in the official MCP Registry (searched the provider name, 2026-10-27).

api.notes: No API or ordering docs. No /.well-known/ucp, agent-card.json, irlpls document found; oauth-protected-resource redirects to HTML (2026-10-27).

consent.unknown: No consent or release process for egocentric footage is published; the recording-app section of the terms says 'By using the recording features of the App, you acknowledge and consent', which concerns app users.

requester.unknown: Objectways publishes no check of who commissions collection or for what.

summary: Objectways (offices in Arizona, USA, and Tamil Nadu, India) lists an Embodied AI data line: egocentric first-person video, RGB-D depth, human-guided teleoperation demonstrations and in-the-wild UMI-gripper demos, with 'on-demand data collection' and 'custom data pipelines'. Its egocentric catalogue shows 15 household-task datasets (1080p, 29.97 fps). Orders go through a contact form; no price, turnaround, collection countries, consent process or licence terms are published, and its website terms cover the site only.
